progressAppend: R61 executed four deterministic permutations of one identical 1941-splat alpha multiset through the actual Three.js r186 SPZLoader and GaussianSplat NormalBlending path. All permutations shared exactly tau=7.9909139785 and sum(alpha^2)=0.0588358475, but center Half/Float error ranged from 0.0084507465 to 0.0729035139. Ascending versus descending Half differed by 0.064453125 while Float differed by only 3.57628e-7; final sRGB pair differences ranged from 6 to 29 codes. This rejects unordered (tau, sum(alpha^2)) as a sufficient precision-risk predictor. It also establishes an r186 WebGL harness constraint: initialize and verify CountingSort.orderRead via updateSort before disabling autoSort. No universal threshold, independent physical root or Mother adoption was added.
